segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר כשאיש הישראלי שהולך לו כמו שהולך (שעל כ"א יש כמה מיני מאורעות וכו') הוא מתאונן שרע לו רח"ל ושהשי"ת עושה לו רע. אומר השי"ת זה נקרא רע ל"ע אני אראה לך מה שנקרא רע ח"ו אבל אם להיפך איך שהולך לו אומר ב"ה "גלובט השי"ת דער פאר אמוצא ההרחבות שזה טוב וכו' אומר השי"ת זה נקרא אצלך טוב אני אראה לך מה שנקרא טוב "דאס היסט בא דיר גוסט איך וועל דיר ווייזין וואס הייסט גוסט".
segments.en: Afterward, some time later — on the night of the winter solstice called blinde nacht [blind night, when the custom is not to study] — Rabbainu sat and told his people a story: a simple village man came to the priests that they should make him a priest over some town. He gave them much money and they made him one, and taught him how to preach at each holiday about the cause of the holiday and the miracle that occurred with it. For the holiday they call the "forty blind men" [forty martyrs], he was taught to say that forty blind men walked in the desert and had only three loaves of bread and ate from this for forty days and there still remained. He forgot how to say it and said it backwards: that forty blind men walked three days in the desert and had only forty loaves of bread and ate it and there still remained. And a great laughter arose — for what miracle is it that forty people ate forty loaves in three days and there was still left over? And the priest was greatly shamed. Rabbainu concluded: that now the cantor had returned to Judaism and become a complete ba'al teshuvah.
